"use client";

import {
  AlertCircleIcon,
  ArrowDown01Icon,
  Tick02Icon,
} from "@hugeicons/core-free-icons";
import { HugeiconsIcon } from "@hugeicons/react";
import type { ChatStatus, UIMessage } from "ai";
import { AnimatePresence, motion, useReducedMotion } from "motion/react";
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import type { CSSProperties, ReactNode } from "react";

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

export type ThinkingStatus = "working" | "done" | "error";
export type ThinkingStepStatus = "pending" | "active" | "done" | "error";
export type ThinkingStateVariant = "panel" | "inline";

export interface ThinkingSource {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  /** Makes the chip a link and supplies the domain for its mark. */
  url?: string;
  /** Replaces the default letter mark, for example with a brand icon. */
  icon?: ReactNode;
}

export interface ThinkingStep {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  /** Defaults to `done`. */
  status?: ThinkingStepStatus;
  /** One or two lines under the label, such as a search query or an error. */
  detail?: string;
  sources?: readonly ThinkingSource[];
}

/** `4s`, `1m 04s`, `1h 02m`. */
export const formatElapsed = (ms: number): string => {
  const total = Number.isFinite(ms) ? Math.max(0, Math.floor(ms / 1000)) : 0;
  const seconds = total % 60;
  const minutes = Math.floor(total / 60) % 60;
  const hours = Math.floor(total / 3600);
  if (hours > 0) {
    return `${hours}h ${String(minutes).padStart(2, "0")}m`;
  }
  if (minutes > 0) {
    return `${minutes}m ${String(seconds).padStart(2, "0")}s`;
  }
  return `${seconds}s`;
};

/** Hostname without `www.`, or `undefined` when the URL does not parse. */
export const sourceDomain = (url?: string): string | undefined => {
  if (!url) {
    return undefined;
  }
  try {
    return new URL(url).hostname.replace(/^www\./u, "");
  } catch {
    return undefined;
  }
};

/** `search_web`, `searchWeb`, and `search-web` all read as `Search web`. */
export const toolLabel = (name: string): string => {
  const words = name
    .replaceAll(/([a-z0-9])([A-Z])/gu, "$1 $2")
    .replaceAll(/[_\-.]+/gu, " ")
    .trim()
    .toLowerCase();
  if (!words) {
    return "Tool";
  }
  return words.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + words.slice(1);
};

const DETAIL_LIMIT = 140;

const lastLine = (text: string): string | undefined => {
  const line = text
    .split("\n")
    .map((part) => part.trim())
    .findLast((part) => part.length > 0);
  if (!line) {
    return undefined;
  }
  return line.length > DETAIL_LIMIT
    ? `${line.slice(0, DETAIL_LIMIT - 1).trimEnd()}…`
    : line;
};

export interface ThinkingStateLabels {
  thinking: string;
  sources: string;
  writing: string;
}

const DEFAULT_LABELS: ThinkingStateLabels = {
  sources: "Reading sources",
  thinking: "Thinking",
  writing: "Writing the answer",
};

export interface ThinkingStateSource {
  /** The assistant message being generated, usually `messages.at(-1)`. */
  message: UIMessage | undefined;
  /** `status` from `useChat`. */
  status: ChatStatus;
  /** Tool name to step label. Unlisted tools use their title or a readable name. */
  toolLabels?: Record<string, string>;
  labels?: Partial<ThinkingStateLabels>;
}

export interface ThinkingStateSnapshot {
  status: ThinkingStatus;
  steps: ThinkingStep[];
}

type MessagePart = UIMessage["parts"][number];
type DraftStep = ThinkingStep & {
  kind: "reasoning" | "tool" | "sources" | "text";
};

const toolStepStatus = (state: string): ThinkingStepStatus => {
  if (state === "output-available") {
    return "done";
  }
  if (state === "output-error" || state === "output-denied") {
    return "error";
  }
  return "active";
};

const toolStep = (
  part: MessagePart,
  toolLabels: Record<string, string>
): DraftStep | null => {
  const isDynamic = part.type === "dynamic-tool";
  if (!(isDynamic || part.type.startsWith("tool-"))) {
    return null;
  }
  if (!("toolCallId" in part && "state" in part)) {
    return null;
  }
  const name =
    isDynamic && "toolName" in part ? part.toolName : part.type.slice(5);
  const title = "title" in part ? part.title : undefined;
  const errorText = "errorText" in part ? part.errorText : undefined;
  return {
    detail: typeof errorText === "string" ? lastLine(errorText) : undefined,
    id: part.toolCallId,
    kind: "tool",
    label: toolLabels[name] ?? title ?? toolLabel(name),
    status: toolStepStatus(String(part.state)),
  };
};

const sourceOf = (part: MessagePart): ThinkingSource | null => {
  if (part.type === "source-url") {
    return {
      id: part.sourceId,
      title: part.title ?? sourceDomain(part.url) ?? part.url,
      url: part.url,
    };
  }
  if (part.type === "source-document") {
    return { id: part.sourceId, title: part.title };
  }
  return null;
};

const readParts = (
  parts: readonly MessagePart[],
  labels: ThinkingStateLabels,
  toolLabels: Record<string, string>
): DraftStep[] => {
  const steps: DraftStep[] = [];
  for (const [index, part] of parts.entries()) {
    const last = steps.at(-1);
    const source = sourceOf(part);
    const tool = toolStep(part, toolLabels);
    if (part.type === "reasoning") {
      steps.push({
        detail: lastLine(part.text),
        id: `reasoning-${index}`,
        kind: "reasoning",
        label: labels.thinking,
        status: part.state === "streaming" ? "active" : "done",
      });
    } else if (tool) {
      steps.push(tool);
    } else if (
      source &&
      last &&
      (last.kind === "tool" || last.kind === "sources")
    ) {
      last.sources = [...(last.sources ?? []), source];
    } else if (source) {
      steps.push({
        id: `sources-${index}`,
        kind: "sources",
        label: labels.sources,
        sources: [source],
        status: "done",
      });
    } else if (part.type === "text" && last?.kind !== "text") {
      steps.push({
        id: `text-${index}`,
        kind: "text",
        label: labels.writing,
        status: part.state === "done" ? "done" : "active",
      });
    }
  }
  return steps;
};

const settle = (
  step: DraftStep,
  status: ThinkingStatus,
  isLast: boolean
): ThinkingStep => {
  const { kind: _kind, ...rest } = step;
  if (rest.status !== "active") {
    return rest;
  }
  if (status === "done") {
    return { ...rest, status: "done" };
  }
  if (status === "error") {
    return { ...rest, status: "error" };
  }
  // Only the newest step can still be running; earlier ones were superseded.
  return isLast ? rest : { ...rest, status: "done" };
};

/**
 * Turns the message `useChat` is streaming into steps. Reasoning, tool calls,
 * sources, and the answer each become a step, in the order they arrive.
 *
 * @example
 * const { messages, status } = useChat();
 * const thinking = thinkingStateFromMessage({
 *   message: messages.at(-1),
 *   status,
 *   toolLabels: { searchWeb: "Searching the web" },
 * });
 * <ThinkingState {...thinking} />
 */
export const thinkingStateFromMessage = ({
  message,
  status: chatStatus,
  toolLabels = {},
  labels,
}: ThinkingStateSource): ThinkingStateSnapshot => {
  let status: ThinkingStatus = "working";
  if (chatStatus === "ready") {
    status = "done";
  } else if (chatStatus === "error") {
    status = "error";
  }
  if (!message || message.role !== "assistant") {
    return { status, steps: [] };
  }
  const drafts = readParts(
    message.parts,
    { ...DEFAULT_LABELS, ...labels },
    toolLabels
  );
  return {
    status,
    steps: drafts.map((step, index) =>
      settle(step, status, index === drafts.length - 1)
    ),
  };
};

export interface ThinkingStateClassNames {
  root?: string;
  header?: string;
  label?: string;
  timer?: string;
  steps?: string;
  step?: string;
  source?: string;
}

export interface ThinkingStateProps {
  /** `panel` is the full card with steps. `inline` is a one-line pill. */
  variant?: ThinkingStateVariant;
  status?: ThinkingStatus;
  steps?: readonly ThinkingStep[];
  /** Overrides the label, which otherwise follows the running step. */
  label?: string;
  /** Epoch milliseconds. Defaults to when the component started working. */
  startedAt?: number;
  /** A fixed elapsed time, for a turn that already finished. Stops the timer. */
  durationMs?: number;
  showTimer?: boolean;
  /** Panel only. Uncontrolled open state. Defaults to open. */
  defaultOpen?: boolean;
  open?: boolean;
  onOpenChange?: (open: boolean) => void;
  /** Panel only. Folds the steps away shortly after the work finishes. */
  collapseOnDone?: boolean;
  /** Sources shown per step before the rest fold into a "+N more" chip. */
  maxSources?: number;
  /** Loads source marks from Google's favicon service. Off by default. */
  favicons?: boolean;
  className?: string;
  classNames?: ThinkingStateClassNames;
  /** Handy for overriding the --thinking-state-* theme vars inline */
  style?: CSSProperties;
}

    ],

];

const DEFAULT_MAX_SOURCES = 4;
const TICK_MS = 250;
const COLLAPSE_MS = 900;
const EASE = [0.4, 0, 0.2, 1] as const;

const THEME_VARS = [
  "[--thinking-state-done:#15803d] dark:[--thinking-state-done:#4ade80]",
  "[--thinking-state-error:var(--destructive)]",
  "[--thinking-state-shadow:0_0_0_1px_rgba(0,0,0,0.06),0_1px_2px_-1px_rgba(0,0,0,0.06),0_2px_4px_0px_rgba(0,0,0,0.04)]",
  "[--thinking-state-shadow-hover:0_0_0_1px_rgba(0,0,0,0.08),0_1px_2px_-1px_rgba(0,0,0,0.08),0_2px_4px_0px_rgba(0,0,0,0.06)]",
  "dark:[--thinking-state-shadow:0_0_0_1px_rgba(255,255,255,0.08)]",
  "dark:[--thinking-state-shadow-hover:0_0_0_1px_rgba(255,255,255,0.13)]",
].join(" ");

const ENTER_CLASS =
  "fade-in-0 slide-in-from-bottom-2 animate-in fill-mode-both duration-300 ease-out motion-reduce:animate-none";

/** Ticks while `running`, then holds the last value. */
const useElapsed = ({
  durationMs,
  running,
  startedAt,
}: {
  durationMs: number | undefined;
  running: boolean;
  startedAt: number | undefined;
}): number => {
  const [elapsed, setElapsed] = useState(0);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!running || durationMs !== undefined) {
      return;
    }
    const origin = startedAt ?? Date.now();
    const tick = () => {
      setElapsed(Math.max(0, Date.now() - origin));
    };
    tick();
    const timer = setInterval(tick, TICK_MS);
    return () => {
      clearInterval(timer);
      tick();
    };
  }, [durationMs, running, startedAt]);

  return durationMs ?? elapsed;
};

const stepStatus = (step: ThinkingStep): ThinkingStepStatus =>
  step.status ?? "done";

const resolveLabel = ({
  elapsed,
  label,
  status,
  steps,
}: {
  elapsed: number;
  label: string | undefined;
  status: ThinkingStatus;
  steps: readonly ThinkingStep[];
}): string => {
  if (status === "error") {
    return label ?? "Stopped";
  }
  if (status === "done") {
    if (label) {
      return label;
    }
    return elapsed >= 1000 ? `Thought for ${formatElapsed(elapsed)}` : "Done";
  }
  const running = steps.findLast((step) => stepStatus(step) === "active");
  return label ?? running?.label ?? DEFAULT_LABELS.thinking;
};

const DashedRing = ({ spinning }: { spinning: boolean }) => {
  const dots = 12;
  const dash = 0.022;
  const gap = 1 / dots - dash;
  return (
    <svg
      aria-hidden="true"
      className={cn(
        "size-full",
        spinning &&
          "animate-spin text-card-foreground [animation-duration:1.8s] motion-reduce:animate-none"
      )}
      viewBox="0 0 24 24"
    >
      <circle
        cx="12"
        cy="12"
        fill="none"
        pathLength={1}
        r="9"
        stroke="currentColor"
        strokeDasharray={`${dash} ${gap}`}
        strokeLinecap="round"
        strokeWidth="2.2"
      />
    </svg>
  );
};

const GLYPH_TONE: Record<ThinkingStepStatus, string> = {
  active: "text-card-foreground",
  done: "text-(--thinking-state-done)",
  error: "text-(--thinking-state-error)",
  pending: "text-muted-foreground/70",
};

const StatusGlyph = ({
  status,
  className,
}: {
  status: ThinkingStepStatus;
  className?: string;
}) => {
  const reduce = useReducedMotion();
  const settled = status === "done" || status === "error";
  return (
    <span
      className={cn(
        "relative inline-flex size-3.5 flex-none items-center justify-center",
        GLYPH_TONE[status],
        className
      )}
      data-slot="thinking-state-glyph"
      data-status={status}
    >
      <AnimatePresence initial={false} mode="popLayout">
        <motion.span
          animate={{ filter: "blur(0px)", opacity: 1, scale: 1 }}
          className="inline-flex size-full items-center justify-center"
          exit={{ filter: "blur(2px)", opacity: 0, scale: 0.4 }}
          initial={{ filter: "blur(2px)", opacity: 0, scale: 0.4 }}
          key={settled ? status : "ring"}
          transition={{ duration: reduce ? 0 : 0.25, ease: EASE }}
        >
          {settled ? (
            <HugeiconsIcon
              aria-hidden="true"
              className="size-full"
              icon={status === "done" ? Tick02Icon : AlertCircleIcon}
              strokeWidth={2.4}
            />
          ) : (
            <DashedRing spinning={status === "active"} />
          )}
        </motion.span>
      </AnimatePresence>
    </span>
  );
};

/** A band of light that sweeps across the text while work is in progress. */
const Shimmer = ({ children }: { children: string }) => {
  const reduce = useReducedMotion();
  if (reduce) {
    return <span>{children}</span>;
  }
  return (
    <motion.span
      animate={{ backgroundPosition: "-50% center" }}
      className="bg-size-[200%_100%] bg-clip-text text-transparent"
      initial={{ backgroundPosition: "150% center" }}
      style={{
        backgroundImage:
          "linear-gradient(90deg, var(--muted-foreground) 35%, var(--card-foreground) 50%, var(--muted-foreground) 65%)",
      }}
      transition={{
        duration: 1.8,
        ease: "linear",
        repeat: Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY,
      }}
    >
      {children}
    </motion.span>
  );
};

const RollingLabel = ({
  className,
  label,
  shimmer,
}: {
  className?: string;
  label: string;
  shimmer: boolean;
}) => {
  const reduce = useReducedMotion();
  return (
    <span
      className={cn("relative inline-flex min-w-0", className)}
      data-slot="thinking-state-label"
    >
      <AnimatePresence initial={false} mode="popLayout">
        <motion.span
          animate={{ filter: "blur(0px)", opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
          className="block min-w-0 truncate"
          exit={{ filter: "blur(3px)", opacity: 0, y: "-0.5em" }}
          initial={{ filter: "blur(3px)", opacity: 0, y: "0.5em" }}
          key={label}
          transition={{ duration: reduce ? 0 : 0.28, ease: EASE }}
        >
          {shimmer ? <Shimmer>{label}</Shimmer> : label}
        </motion.span>
      </AnimatePresence>
    </span>
  );
};

const faviconUrl = (domain: string): string =>
  `https://www.google.com/s2/favicons?domain=${encodeURIComponent(domain)}&sz=32`;

const SourceMark = ({
  favicons,
  source,
}: {
  favicons: boolean;
  source: ThinkingSource;
}) => {
  const [failed, setFailed] = useState(false);
  const domain = sourceDomain(source.url);
  const letter = (domain ?? source.title).trim().charAt(0);
  if (source.icon) {
    return (
      <span className="inline-flex size-4 flex-none items-center justify-center [&_svg]:size-3">
        {source.icon}
      </span>
    );
  }
  if (favicons && domain && !failed) {
    return (
      // oxlint-disable-next-line nextjs/no-img-element -- installs outside Next.js, and the URL is a remote favicon service
      <img
        alt=""
        className="size-4 flex-none rounded-full bg-card"
        height={16}
        loading="lazy"
        onError={() => {
          setFailed(true);
        }}
        src={faviconUrl(domain)}
        width={16}
      />
    );
  }
  return (
    <span
      aria-hidden="true"
      className="inline-flex size-4 flex-none items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-card text-[9px] leading-none font-semibold text-muted-foreground uppercase shadow-[0_0_0_1px_rgba(0,0,0,0.06)] dark:shadow-[0_0_0_1px_rgba(255,255,255,0.1)]"
    >
      {letter}
    </span>
  );
};

const CHIP_CLASS =
  "inline-flex h-6 max-w-full min-w-0 items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full bg-muted pr-2 pl-1 text-xs leading-4 text-card-foreground dark:bg-background";

const SourceChip = ({
  className,
  favicons,
  index,
  source,
}: {
  className?: string;
  favicons: boolean;
  index: number;
  source: ThinkingSource;
}) => {
  const reduce = useReducedMotion();
  const domain = sourceDomain(source.url);
  const content = (
    <>
      <SourceMark favicons={favicons} source={source} />
      <span className="min-w-0 truncate">{source.title}</span>
    </>
  );
  return (
    <motion.li
      animate={{ filter: "blur(0px)", opacity: 1, scale: 1 }}
      className="flex max-w-full min-w-0"
      data-slot="thinking-state-source"
      initial={{ filter: "blur(3px)", opacity: 0, scale: 0.94 }}
      transition={{
        delay: reduce ? 0 : Math.min(index, 6) * 0.04,
        duration: reduce ? 0 : 0.25,
        ease: EASE,
      }}
    >
      {source.url ? (
        <a
          className={cn(
            CHIP_CLASS,
            "transition-colors duration-150 ease-out hover:bg-foreground/10 focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring/50 focus-visible:outline-none motion-reduce:transition-none dark:hover:bg-foreground/10 dark:focus-visible:ring-ring/80",
            className
          )}
          href={source.url}
          rel="noreferrer"
          target="_blank"
          title={domain}
        >
          {content}
        </a>
      ) : (
        <span className={cn(CHIP_CLASS, className)}>{content}</span>
      )}
    </motion.li>
  );
};

const SourceList = ({
  className,
  favicons,
  max,
  sources,
}: {
  className?: string;
  favicons: boolean;
  max: number;
  sources: readonly ThinkingSource[];
}) => {
  const [expanded, setExpanded] = useState(false);
  const limit = Math.max(0, max);
  const shown = expanded ? sources : sources.slice(0, limit);
  const hidden = sources.length - shown.length;
  return (
    <ul
      className="m-0 flex min-w-0 list-none flex-wrap gap-1 p-0"
      data-slot="thinking-state-sources"
    >
      {shown.map((source, index) => (
        <SourceChip
          className={className}
          favicons={favicons}
          index={index}
          key={source.id}
          source={source}
        />
      ))}
      {hidden > 0 ? (
        <li className="flex">
          <button
            className="inline-flex h-6 cursor-pointer items-center rounded-full border-0 bg-transparent px-2 text-xs leading-4 text-muted-foreground tabular-nums transition-colors duration-150 ease-out hover:bg-foreground/6 hover:text-card-foreground focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring/50 focus-visible:outline-none motion-reduce:transition-none dark:focus-visible:ring-ring/80"
            onClick={() => {
              setExpanded(true);
            }}
            type="button"
          >
            +{hidden} more
          </button>
        </li>
      ) : null}
    </ul>
  );
};

const STEP_LABEL_TONE: Record<ThinkingStepStatus, string> = {
  active: "text-card-foreground",
  done: "text-card-foreground",
  error: "text-card-foreground",
  pending: "text-muted-foreground",
};

const ThinkingStepRow = ({
  classNames,
  favicons,
  isLast,
  maxSources,
  step,
}: {
  classNames?: ThinkingStateClassNames;
  favicons: boolean;
  isLast: boolean;
  maxSources: number;
  step: ThinkingStep;
}) => {
  const reduce = useReducedMotion();
  const status = stepStatus(step);
  const sources = step.sources ?? [];
  return (
    <motion.li
      animate={{
        filter: "blur(0px)",
        height: "auto",
        opacity: 1,
        // Clip only while growing, so focus rings on sources are not cut off.
        transitionEnd: { overflow: "visible" },
      }}
      className="relative"
      data-slot="thinking-state-step"
      data-status={status}
      initial={{
        filter: "blur(4px)",
        height: 0,
        opacity: 0,
        overflow: "hidden",
      }}
      transition={{ duration: reduce ? 0 : 0.3, ease: EASE }}
    >
      <div
        className={cn(
          "flex min-w-0 gap-2",
          isLast ? "pb-0" : "pb-2.5",
          classNames?.step
        )}
      >
        <span className="relative flex w-6 flex-none justify-center pt-[3px]">
          <StatusGlyph status={status} />
          {isLast ? null : (
            <span
              aria-hidden="true"
              className="absolute top-5 -bottom-2 left-1/2 w-px -translate-x-1/2 rounded-full bg-foreground/12"
            />
          )}
        </span>
        <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-1 flex-col gap-1.5">
          <div
            className={cn(
              "text-[13px] leading-5 text-pretty",
              STEP_LABEL_TONE[status]
            )}
          >
            {step.label}
          </div>
          {step.detail ? (
            <p
              className={cn(
                "-mt-1 line-clamp-2 text-xs leading-4 text-pretty",
                status === "error"
                  ? "text-(--thinking-state-error)"
                  : "text-muted-foreground"
              )}
            >
              {step.detail}
            </p>
          ) : null}
          {sources.length > 0 ? (
            <SourceList
              className={classNames?.source}
              favicons={favicons}
              max={maxSources}
              sources={sources}
            />
          ) : null}
        </div>
      </div>
    </motion.li>
  );
};

const overallGlyph = (status: ThinkingStatus): ThinkingStepStatus => {
  if (status === "working") {
    return "active";
  }
  return status;
};

const Timer = ({
  className,
  elapsed,
  visible,
}: {
  className?: string;
  elapsed: number;
  visible: boolean;
}) => (
  <span
    aria-hidden="true"
    className={cn(
      "flex-none text-xs leading-4 text-muted-foreground tabular-nums transition-opacity duration-200 ease-out motion-reduce:transition-none",
      visible ? "opacity-100" : "opacity-0",
      className
    )}
    data-slot="thinking-state-timer"
  >
    {formatElapsed(elapsed)}
  </span>
);

/** Open state for the panel, with an optional fold once the work is done. */
const usePanelOpen = ({
  collapseOnDone,
  defaultOpen,
  onOpenChange,
  open,
  status,
}: {
  collapseOnDone: boolean;
  defaultOpen: boolean;
  onOpenChange: ((open: boolean) => void) | undefined;
  open: boolean | undefined;
  status: ThinkingStatus;
}) => {
  const [uncontrolled, setUncontrolled] = useState(defaultOpen);
  const [touched, setTouched] = useState(false);
  const isOpen = open ?? uncontrolled;

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!collapseOnDone || touched || status !== "done") {
      return;
    }
    const timer = setTimeout(() => {
      setUncontrolled(false);
      onOpenChange?.(false);
    }, COLLAPSE_MS);
    return () => {
      clearTimeout(timer);
    };
  }, [collapseOnDone, onOpenChange, status, touched]);

  const toggle = () => {
    setTouched(true);
    if (open === undefined) {
      setUncontrolled(!isOpen);
    }
    onOpenChange?.(!isOpen);
  };

  return { isOpen, toggle };
};

export const ThinkingState = ({
  variant = "panel",
  status = "working",
  steps = DEFAULT_STEPS,
  label,
  startedAt,
  durationMs,
  showTimer = true,
  defaultOpen = true,
  open,
  onOpenChange,
  collapseOnDone = false,
  maxSources = DEFAULT_MAX_SOURCES,
  favicons = false,
  className,
  classNames,
  style,
}: ThinkingStateProps) => {
  const reduce = useReducedMotion();
  const working = status === "working";
  const elapsed = useElapsed({ durationMs, running: working, startedAt });
  const { isOpen, toggle } = usePanelOpen({
    collapseOnDone,
    defaultOpen,
    onOpenChange,
    open,
    status,
  });
  const text = resolveLabel({ elapsed, label, status, steps });
  const glyph = overallGlyph(status);

  if (variant === "inline") {
    return (
      <span
        className={cn(
          THEME_VARS,
          ENTER_CLASS,
          "inline-flex h-7 max-w-full min-w-0 items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full bg-card pr-2.5 pl-2 text-[13px] leading-5 text-card-foreground shadow-(--thinking-state-shadow)",
          className,
          classNames?.root
        )}
        data-slot="thinking-state"
        data-status={status}
        data-variant="inline"
        style={style}
      >
        <StatusGlyph status={glyph} />
        <output
          aria-live="polite"
          className={cn("flex min-w-0 font-medium", classNames?.label)}
        >
          <RollingLabel label={text} shimmer={working} />
        </output>
        {showTimer && working ? (
          <Timer className={classNames?.timer} elapsed={elapsed} visible />
        ) : null}
      </span>
    );
  }

  const hasSteps = steps.length > 0;
  return (
    <section
      aria-label="Assistant activity"
      className={cn(
        THEME_VARS,
        ENTER_CLASS,
        "flex w-full max-w-full min-w-0 flex-col rounded-2xl bg-card p-3 text-card-foreground shadow-(--thinking-state-shadow) transition-shadow duration-150 ease-out hover:shadow-(--thinking-state-shadow-hover)",
        className,
        classNames?.root
      )}
      data-slot="thinking-state"
      data-state={isOpen ? "open" : "closed"}
      data-status={status}
      data-variant="panel"
      style={style}
    >
      <button
        aria-expanded={hasSteps ? isOpen : undefined}
        className={cn(
          "relative flex h-6 w-full min-w-0 items-center gap-2 rounded-md border-0 bg-transparent p-0 text-left after:absolute after:-inset-1.5 after:content-[''] focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring/50 focus-visible:outline-none dark:focus-visible:ring-ring/80",
          hasSteps ? "cursor-pointer" : "cursor-default",
          classNames?.header
        )}
        data-slot="thinking-state-header"
        disabled={!hasSteps}
        onClick={toggle}
        type="button"
      >
        <span className="inline-flex size-6 flex-none items-center justify-center rounded-md bg-muted dark:bg-background">
          <StatusGlyph status={glyph} />
        </span>
        <output
          aria-live="polite"
          className={cn(
            "flex min-w-0 flex-1 text-[13px] leading-5 font-medium tracking-[-0.01em]",
            classNames?.label
          )}
        >
          <RollingLabel label={text} shimmer={working} />
        </output>
        {showTimer ? (
          <Timer
            className={classNames?.timer}
            elapsed={elapsed}
            visible={working}
          />
        ) : null}
        {hasSteps ? (
          <HugeiconsIcon
            aria-hidden="true"
            className={cn(
              "size-3 flex-none text-muted-foreground transition-transform duration-150 ease-out motion-reduce:transition-none",
              isOpen ? "rotate-0" : "-rotate-90"
            )}
            icon={ArrowDown01Icon}
            strokeWidth={2}
          />
        ) : null}
      </button>
      <AnimatePresence initial={false}>
        {isOpen && hasSteps ? (
          <motion.div
            animate={{ height: "auto", opacity: 1 }}
            className="overflow-hidden"
            exit={{ height: 0, opacity: 0 }}
            initial={{ height: 0, opacity: 0 }}
            key="steps"
            transition={{ duration: reduce ? 0 : 0.25, ease: EASE }}
          >
            <ul
              className={cn(
                "m-0 flex list-none flex-col p-0 pt-3",
                classNames?.steps
              )}
              data-slot="thinking-state-steps"
            >
              {steps.map((step, index) => (
                <ThinkingStepRow
                  classNames={classNames}
                  favicons={favicons}
                  isLast={index === steps.length - 1}
                  key={step.id}
                  maxSources={maxSources}
                  step={step}
                />
              ))}
            </ul>
          </motion.div>
        ) : null}
      </AnimatePresence>
    </section>
  );
};
